fact: On 20 August 2025 the UGPTN of the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Digital Affairs issued a call for consultants to map civil-registry offices and prepare a digitisation roadmap for civil registration, under a World Bank credit of US$400 million co-financed by AFD with EUR 100 million.
title: Appui au développement du système d'état civil en République Démocratique du Congo
